title: DEV-001: failing staff hold-alert tests for Code pickup
public_pr_body:
Tests first only; no application implementation. Committed corrected harness 2f3d3f1 reports 2 passed, 4 failed, zero skipped (exit 1), reproducing actual generic Nothing was saved / permission wording rather than a module/setup failure. Original failed logs remain. Lint and TypeScript pass after a test-only local fixture import correction; its earlier typecheck failure is retained too.

The real 147 dln_numbering_not_set hint must produce plain staff wording and an accessible alert; a proposed distinct company_on_hold signal has a separate sentence, which Code must implement and verify server-side. Unknown permission/network errors must not be mislabelled as holds. Tests also verify input preservation and no success callback/toast/audit on refusal.

Pinned public 9d7725e form/helper fixtures exercise the existing UI on a main-based branch. Component logic is unchanged; only the helper import is relocated for TypeScript. No candidate/go-live/app file is edited. A persistent company-wide banner, authenticated signal, navigation/offline/reset rules and full wiring remain implementation work for Code. No raw DB/other-company details should be shown.

DEV-001: red contracts ready, 2 pass / 4 expected fail / 0 skipped. Separate branch from main, tests/docs only, no SQL/provider/real data/private files, no merge, no #359/go-live edit and no message to John.
